_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Monday — policy-and-platform setup day before Tuesday's Mythos announcement. THREE coordinated stories: (1) OpenAI ships 13-page 'Industrial Policy for the Intelligence Age' with seven concrete proposals (AI access as fundamental right, tax reform, four-day work week, public wealth fund, grid build-out, etc.) + $100K/$1M-API-credits fellowships pilot — explicit policy-narrative grab ahead of IPO; TechPolicy.Press calls it 'policymercial' but sets agenda. (2) Microsoft completes agent-platform triad: Agent Framework 1.0.0 (control-plane / application separation, pre-configured Azure connectivity), plus Agent Governance Toolkit (Apr 2-3) + Copilot Studio multi-agent GA (last Fri) — first vendor with complete build/govern/distribute stack in market. (3) Mizuho 'Agent Factory' cuts build time ~70% (2 weeks → days) — first major Japanese megabank to industrialise agent build, Nomura/MUFG/Daiwa tracking. Plus Rocket (Surat) 'vibe-McKinsey' 1.5M users in 180 countries, $15M Salesforce Ventures+Accel+Together Fund — first scaled agent-disrupts-consulting story. Schneier blog + Fortune pre-disclosure (27-yr OpenBSD, 16-yr FFmpeg) shift Mythos coverage from rumour to fait-accompli. Jack Clark Import AI 452 publishes cyber-doubling-time data: GPT-5.3 Codex + Opus 4.6 at 50% on ~3.1-3.2hr expert tasks; doubling-time steepened to 5.7 months since 2024; open-weight GLM-5 lags ~5.7 months — Tuesday Mythos lands into this already-published slope. Research: GrandCode 'agentic GRPO' grandmaster-level Codeforces, InCoder-32B-Thinking error-driven CoT, RLSD self-distilled RLVR, Agentic-MME process-verified + 'overthinking' metric, AgentHazard computer-use-agent threat surface, AgentSocialBench 'abstraction paradox', Test-Time Scaling Makes Overtraining Compute-Optimal (corrects Chinchilla for inference-heavy deployments), Swift-SVD low-rank LLM compression. Stage moves: NONE today — slow EMAs hold structural positions despite heavy news; all the new activity feeds existing consolidating-stage cohort. New topic 'ai-industrial-policy' considered but rolled into ai-governance + workforce-reallocation per stickiness/minimum-three-topic rule.
